title: Southwest Tanna language - Wikipedia
text: Southwest Tanna is a dialect chain spoken on the southwestern coast of Tanna Island in Vanuatu. Lynch names three major dialects: Nivhaal in the north-west of the language area, Nivai in the south-west, and Nelpwaai in the north-east.

title: Tanna, Southwest Language (NWI)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Southwest Tanna is a stable indigenous language of Vanuatu. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
